channel.title: Times of The World
channel.description: The news, verified. Independent geopolitical news.

item.title: The US-Israel war on Iran: strikes began February 28 — Trump rules out escalation before the midterms
item.description: Al Jazeera's live reporting continues to track the war; Trump says he has ruled out a fresh attack before the November 3 midterms while citing 'productive discussions' with Tehran.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition launches large-scale operation against Ansar Allah as the Red Sea–Hormuz corridor tightens
item.description: An Ansar Allah-linked attack on Riyadh's King Khalid airport reportedly killed three Saudi nationals; separately, the IRGC struck the LPG carrier NV Sunshine near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump and Putin struck a diesel deal to blunt Iran-war fuel prices
item.description: Over 300,000 metric tons of Russian fuel would flow under a temporary US sanctions lift, easing the price shock from the war on Iran — but analysts doubt it will be enough.

item.title: One year on, Gaza's promised 'day after' has not arrived — AP
item.description: A year after the US-brokered ceasefire took effect, all captives are home but Israel controls ~70% of Gaza, reconstruction has not begun, and strikes continue — civil defence reports three Palestinians killed Monday in an al-Mawasi camp, including a seven-year-old girl.

item.title: G7 weighs a 100-million-barrel oil release to steady war-time markets
item.description: A coordinated strategic-reserve release is reportedly under discussion — a measure of how seriously governments take the energy shock from the Iran war.

item.title: Shipping and insurance markets are repricing the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Explosions reported in the strait and the IRGC strike on the LPG carrier NV Sunshine are forcing insurers and tanker operators to recalculate risk on the world's most critical oil artery.

item.title: Putin meets Pezeshkian in Ashgabat and pledges mediation
item.description: The Russian president met his Iranian counterpart ahead of the CIS summit, offering to mediate as the war on Iran grinds into its eighth month.

item.title: Treasury license would let Russian diesel flow through April 2027
item.description: The diesel deal's sanctions carve-out reportedly extends through April 2027 — turning a wartime fix into a year-plus arrangement.

item.title: US sanctions the entire ICC — Rubio vows to dismantle it 'brick by brick'
item.description: The US sanctioned the Hague court as an institution on Oct 9, hours after a former ICC judge won the Nobel Peace Prize — demanding the Netanyahu/Gallant warrants be dropped and issuing an April 2027 ultimatum. Canada, France, Germany, Japan and the UK rejected the move.

item.title: Russia is supplying missiles to Iran as Tehran rebuilds its arsenal, report says
item.description: Iran retains production capacity and substantial ballistic missile stocks despite eight months of US-Israeli airstrikes, according to Bloomberg reporting cited by Haaretz.
